notes.title: LUDUS VETITUS Demo Update v1.10
notes.content:
I recently thought about expanding the demo build to include more seekers, so I chose to!
This is what has happened and what is to come:

[h2]BUG FIXES:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed fatal error at the breaker box
[*]Fixed animation issues
[*]Fixed sound issues to where one cancels out the other
[/list]

[h2]CHANGES:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Changed certain dialog text
[*]Improved seeker sounds
[/list]

[h2]ADDITIONS:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a new seeker: The Skin Stealer
[*]Added a version text in the menu
[/list]

[h2]WHAT WILL BE NEXT?[/h2]
After the addition of the skin stealer, I will start on improving him and Umbra if need be. As I do so, I will also start implementing a new seeker (I won't say who)!

If you want to know what's being done, you can check my Twitter (X) account:
https://twitter.com/Dismay_Studio
Have fun!
[b]Bulderme[/b]

notes.title: LUDUS VETITUS Demo Update v1.06
notes.content:
First Announcement of the demo page!
This post contains what has changed and what could come around soon!

[h2]BUG FIXES:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed dialog typo
[*]Fixed bug to where the hide animation plays when player moves
[*]Fixed cursor issues to where it appears over cut scenes
[/list]

[h2]CHANGES:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Changed certain dialog text
[*]Improved enemy AI
[/list]

[h2]ADDITIONS:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added enemy breathing sounds to help players locate the enemy
[*]Added tips to give players information to help win the game
[/list]

[h2]WHAT WILL BE NEXT?[/h2]
Hopefully in a matter of weeks, I can add an additional enemy to the game! Enemies can have new abilities to add new challenges and they can also have new scary designs. Making a trailer is also on my list of things I want to knock out, so hopefully you can expect a new trailer to give you insight on what is to be expected in the demo.

If you want to know what's being done, you can check my Twitter (X) account: https://twitter.com/Dismay_Studio

Have fun!
[b]Bulderme[/b]
